newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-INJURIES PLAGUE ISRAELI WORLD CUP TEAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURIES PLAGUE ISRAELI WORLD CUP TEAM.

text.p: Israel have recalled right back Moshe Glam to cover for injured midfielder David Amsalem in Sunday's World Cup qualifier against Cyprus in Limassol.
Five of Israel's 20-man squad are carrying leg injuries into the group five match with Amsalem and captain Ronnen Harazi doubtful starters.
Glam has not played for Israel since the start of the World Cup qualifying campaign and has hardly played for his club, Maccabi Haifa, while awaiting a transfer to another side.
Harazi has been out of action since Israel's last qualifying match against Russia in Tel Aviv last month.
Goalkeepers - Bonnie Ginsburg (Maccabi Haifa), Rafi Cohen (Hapoel Haifa).

Defenders - Felix Halfon (Hapoel Tel Aviv), Gadi Brumer (Maccabi Tel Aviv), Moshe Glam (Maccabi Haifa), Amir Shelah (Maccabi Tel Aviv), Nir Klinger (Maccabi Tel Aviv), Yossi Abuksis (Betar Jerusalem), Alon Harazi (Maccabi Haifa), Alon Hazan (Maccabi Haifa), Tal Banin (Hapoel Haifa).
Midfielders - Avi Nimni (Maccabi Tel Aviv), Eyal Berkowitz (Southampton), Itzik Zohar (Betar Jerusalem), Arik Bennado (Maccabi Haifa), David Amsalem (Betar Jerusalem).
Forwards - Eli Driks (Maccabi Tel Aviv), Ronnen Harazi (Betar Jerusalem), Haim Revivo (Celta Vigo), Ronnie Rosenthal (Tottenham).
